definitions.full: H8548. tamid תָּמִיד noun masculine Dan 12:11 continuity (perhaps originally extent ; Late Hebrew as Biblical Hebrew, Ecclus תמיד Ecclesiasticus 45:14); — ׳ת always absolute; — 1 earliest and oftenest as adverb , continually: a. of going on without interruption = continuously , Hosea 12:7 ; Jer 6:7 ; Nahum 3:19 ; Isa 21:8 ; 49:16 ; 51:13 (+ כָּלהַֿיּוֺם ), 52:5 (+ id. ), 60:11 (|| וָלַיְלָח יַוֺמָם , 62:6 (+ וְכָלהַֿלַּיְלָה כָּלהַֿיּוֺם ), 65:3 ; Obadiah 16; Hab 1:17 ; Deut 11:12 ; 1Kin 10:8 2Chr 9:7 ; 1Chr 16:11 , 37 ; especially (sometimes hyperbole) in Psalms : Psa 16:8 ; 25:15 ; 34:2 (|| בְּכָלעֵֿת ), 35:27 ; compare 40:17 ; 70:5 ; 38:18 ; 40:12 ; 50:8 ; 51:5 ; 69:24 ; 71:6 ; 71:14 ; 72:15 ; 73:23 ; 74:23 ; 105:4 ; 109:15 ; 109:19 ; 119:44 (+ לְעוֺלָם וֶָעך׃ ), Psalm 40:109; v<Bible/VERSE ONLY: 119:117 (so also 16:5 , for תומי ᵑ0 , Bi Che; תּוֺסיף Ol Bae); Prov 5:19 (|| בִּכָלעֵֿת ), 6:21 ; 15:15 ; 28:14 ; also Ezek 38:8 (strike out ᵑ6 Co Toy Hpt. Berthol), Lev 6:6 (P; of fire, || תִכְבֶּה לֹא ), and Lev 46:14 (but ᵐ5 תּ ׳חֻקַּת Co Berthol); also in ritual, 24:8 (H), compare Exod 25:30 (P; shew-bread), Lev 24:2-3 , 4 (H), compare Exod 27:20 (P; of lamp), 28:29-30 , 38 . b. of regular repetition: meals 2Sam 9:7 , 10 , 13 ; 2Kin 25:29 = Jer 52:33 ; journeys 2Kin 4:19 ; compare Num 9:16 ; Psa 71:3 ; of ritual: sacrifice, תָּמִיד לַיּוֺם Exod 29:38 ; compare 1Chr 16:40 ; 23:31 ; 2Chr 24:14 . 2 as substantive: a. of uninterrupted continuity , ת ׳אַנְשֵׁי Ezek 39:14 men of continuity , i.e. men continually employed for the purpose; הַתּ ׳לֶחֶם Num 4:7 the bread of continuity , i.e. the bread that is always there, so ת ׳מַעֲרֶכֶת 2Chr 2:3 , and perhaps ת ׳חֲצֹצְרוֺת 1Chr 16:6 . b. of regular repetition מ ׳אֲרֻחַת 2Kin 25:30 , i.e. a regular allowance, = Jer 52:34 ; especially of ritual: ת ׳קְטֹרֶת Exod 30:8 (P); most often ת ׳עֹלַת Ezek 46:15 (every morning), Exod 29:42 (morning and evening, so) Num 28:6 ; Ezra 3:5 , so read also Num 28:3 (Di) for ת ׳עוֺלָה ᵑ0 ( לַיּוֺם ); הַת ׳עֹלַת 28:10 , 15 , 23 , 24 , 31 ; 29:6 , 11 , 16 , 19 , 22 , 25 , 28 , 31 , 34 , 38 ; Neh Neh 10:35 ; rarely ת ׳מִנְחַת Num 4:16 (P), Neh 10:34 ; as appositive, ת ׳מִנְחָה Lev 6:13 meal-offering as a regular observance (compare Ges § 131 , 2 (b) Da Synt.§ 29 (b); on text see Di, Now Archaeology ii. 124 f. ), (and Num 28:3 ᵑ0 , but see above) c. (late) ׳הַת alone = daily (morning and evening) burnt-offering (Now Archaeology ii. 222 f. ) Dan 8:11-12 , 13 ; 11:31 ; 12:11 (so Talmud, even in plural תְּמִידִין ).
